snippet.title: BLACK JACKET Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

WISHLIST NOW! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100370/Black_Jacket/
